title: Mounted pair reader detects changed native position and exact restoration

verification.actor: Current mounted Cyndaquil155, current field and attached player anchor, idle after excluded warmup.
verification.trigger: Arm the same pose reader, observe one complete idle update, change only mount pos_x by one without executing guest instructions, then restore exact bytes.
verification.observable: The same reader and unchanged pair checker reject the changed position. Clean and restored data match exactly. Native clocks and registers do not change. Reader and private session close.

setupMutations.change: Disposable test.sav; checked own-path teleport, party0 Cyndaquil and mounted spawn. Ten north input frames and an idle wait are excluded warmup, not movement proof. No other species destination or user save is changed.
Paused same-reader control changes only the exact current mount pos_x bytes by one, restores in finally and verifies readback. Failed restore stops the private core.

limits: This is reader calibration only. It grants no natural movement, spawning, terrain, pacing or soak credit.

control.fault: Current mount position differs by one in native memory during a stopped-guest read.
control.expectedFailure: The unchanged pair checker rejects that read; exact restored read passes before execution resumes.

events.value: Own mounted Cyndaquil fixture, excluded warmup and current binding.
Coherent idle sample, same-reader position fault, exact restore and reader close.

stop.condition: One coherent idle sample and one restored native pose control, then clean private session close.

invariants: Every active actor has an attached presentation
